title: Glowing watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <rect x='20' y='42' width='44' height='38' rx='8' fill='#3fa9f5'/>
  <!-- lighter shade for edge -->
  <rect x='20' y='42' width='44' height='8' rx='6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M34 42 C34 24, 54 24, 54 42' fill='none' stroke='#2a7fc4' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 42 C34 24, 54 24, 54 42' fill='none' stroke='#8fdcff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M64 50 L88 36' stroke='#3fa9f5' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 50 L88 36' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rose head -->
  <ellipse cx='89' cy='35' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(-30 89 35)'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='33' r='1.6' fill='#ffe6b0'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='31' r='1.6' fill='#ffe6b0'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='36' r='1.6' fill='#ffe6b0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#ffe6b0'/>
  <!-- water drops -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='46' r='2.4' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='52' r='2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- top rim highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='62' width='32' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9fe4ff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
